entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Sections 420, 120- B, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 04 years with fine of Rs.2,000/-, R.I. for 03 years with fine of Rs.2,000/-, R.I. for 05 years with fine of Rs.2,000/-, R.I. for 03 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- and R.I. for 03 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- respectively, with default stipulation, vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 16.03.2023 passed by Ist Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge, Special Court (Prevention of Corruption) Act, Indore (M.P.) in S.T. No.714/2014.
3.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that jail sentence of all the co-appellants Ranvijay Pratap Singh and Dhirendra Yadav has been suspended and they have been enlarged on bail vide order dated 08.05.2023 by this Court.
Case of the appellant is similar with the aforesaid co-accused persons therefore, the present appellant is also entitled to get similar benefit.

It is further submitted that final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future therefore, it is prayed that the remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
4 .

Learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer of the appellants but has not disputed that case of appellant is identical with the co-accused persons Ranvijay Pratap Singh and Dhirendra Yadav.
We have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case it is not disputed that case of the appellant is identical with co-accused persons Ranvijay Pratap Singh and Dhirendra Yadav, therefore he is entitled to get similar treatment therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are inclined to suspend the jail sentence of the appellant hence, I.A. No.5299/2023, is allowed.

sentences.text:
It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, Appellant -Aashish Shrivastava shall be released on bail, on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with two solvent sureties of Rs. 50,000/- each to the satisfaction of trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 22.08.2023,
and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
for urgent hearing also stands closed.
